ContentPatch.description:
`PATCH /content/{type}/{id}`: every member is optional and an absent one keeps the
stored value. `null` is accepted only by `parent_id` (move to the top level) and
`excerpt` (derive it from the body again); elsewhere, `slug` included, it is
`400 malformed-json`.

terms.description: Replaces the item's terms; `[]` removes them all.

ContentSummaryDto.description: A list entry: the item's columns without `body`.

fields.description:
The field schema items are validated against; `[]` means items take `{}` only
(plus `featured_image`). `null`: the type has no schema and its items take any
`fields` object (the built-in types until one is set).

hierarchical.description: Whether items can have a parent (cannot change).

fields.description:
The schema; absent is `[]` (items take `{}` only), `null` registers the type
without a schema (items take any object).

name.description:
`[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}`; not a router word, type, taxonomy or top-level post or
page slug, and not a first segment of a permalink structure.

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every type.

fields.description:
Absent keeps the schema, a list replaces it (`[]`: items take `{}` only), `null`
removes it (items take any object). Stored items are validated on their next save.

CreatedTokenDto.description:
The created token. `token` is the bearer value (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`),
shown **only in this response**; it cannot be read again.

FieldDefDto.description:
One field of a content type's schema. Names match `[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}` and are
unique per level; at most 100 fields per level; `featured_image` is a core field that
every schema allows and none may define.

fields.description:
The sub-fields of a `repeater` (repeaters nest at most 2 deep); empty for every
other kind.

options.description: The choices of a `select` (1 to 100); empty for every other kind.

FieldError.description:
One entry of `errors`: what is wrong with one input (`field` = the JSON path or
parameter name, when known).

FieldKindDto.description: The kind of a custom field.

GrantReportDto.description:

(P3, P6).

added.description:
What the grant compared against does not cover: for an upload, the installed
version's grant (all of `items` for a new plugin; a non-empty `added` on an
update widens the grant, R1); for an installed plugin, its own stored grant
(empty when it was installed with approval).

fingerprint.description:
For an upload: what `POST /plugins` must carry as `approve` to install exactly
it (SHA-256 over plugin, version, artifact and grant). For an installed plugin:
the fingerprint it was approved with.

created.description: Rows whose source had no redirect.

updated.description: Rows that replaced the target and code of an existing redirect.
